competitors.title: GPT-5 Turbo Review 2026: Native Image+Audio, Better JSON, April 7 Release
key_points: GPT-5 Turbo = GPT-5.4 mini (March 17, 2026), originally GPT-5 mini (Aug 7, 2025)
Native multimodal: text, images, audio in single API call — no separate vision or speech-to-text API
400K token context window (3x GPT-4o mini's 128K)
$0.15/M input tokens, $0.60/M output tokens — same price as GPT-4o mini
Strict JSON mode with CFG engine — zero schema violations across 10,000 test calls
2x faster inference than original GPT-5 mini
Audio: MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A; Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF up to 2048x2048
OCR accuracy >98% on printed text, handwriting ~91%
40-60% reduction in end-to-end response time for hybrid voice+vision tasks
Benchmarks: ~55% SWE-bench Verified, ~88% MMLU (vs GPT-4o mini ~30%/~82%)
GPT-5.5: 88.7% SWE-bench, 92.4% MMLU, 1M context, $5/$30 per M tokens
GPT-5.4 flagship: 80% SWE-bench, ~90% MMLU, 400K context, $2.50/$15
Hallucination reduced 60% in GPT-5.5 vs GPT-5.4
OSWorld: GPT-5.4 achieves 75% (surpassing human baseline 72.4%)
MRCR v2 at 1M tokens improved from 36.6% to 74.0% in 5.5 generation
Limitations: no computer use in mini tier, complex reasoning gap to flagship

GPT-5 Turbo runs 2x faster than original GPT-5 mini while approaching flagship GPT-5.4 performance
40-60% reduction in end-to-end response time for hybrid voice+vision tasks vs GPT-4o multi-service pipeline

angles: GPT-5 Turbo eliminates the multi-service pipeline: one API call replaces Whisper + Vision + Chat for voice+vision tasks
Strict JSON mode is a genuine architectural change — not a prompt-level improvement — eliminating 2-5% silent failure rate from GPT-4o's JSON mode
GPT-5 Turbo is the rational default for 80%+ of production workloads; GPT-5.5 is overkill for most applications
The upgrade path from GPT-4o mini to GPT-5.4 mini is a model name change — same API contract, same pricing, dramatically better results
GPT-5 Turbo vs Gemini 3.1 Flash: GPT-5 wins on features (strict JSON, native audio), Gemini wins on cost (50% cheaper)
GPT-5 Turbo's 400K context enables RAG pipelines with 200-300 chunks in a single call without truncation
Voice+vision agent in one API call: microphone capture → base64 → single chat completions call with Pydantic schema — 800-1200ms latency
The mini tier trades reasoning depth for speed/cost — use GPT-5.5 only for multi-step theorem proving, full-codebase analysis, or autonomous computer use
